utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hana, the blade's stuck. Probably something jammed under the deck.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about helping? I thought you were just making small talk.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I'm serious. Let's get that lawnmower fixed so I can stop borrowing yours.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just glad you're both willing to help. I hope we can get a decent crew together before the sun goes down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, don't you worry, Pia — I've already got a few neighbors interested, and I saw Vik rounding up some tools earlier. This is gonna come together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief to hear about Vik, but I still can't help wondering if we've got enough extension cords to reach the far end of the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, I'm so glad you're here! We're kicking off the repair drive Saturday at 9 AM at Mrs. Gable's on Elm Street — can we count on you to help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there on Saturday at 9 AM. Mrs. Gable's on Elm Street, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Mara! She'll be so relieved to have your help — I'll add you to the list right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... do you remember what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We're checking the roof for damage before the next rain. Remember?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, you heard about that repair drive this weekend? I'm hoping someone can tackle my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Ira! We're fixing up the community garden tools this Saturday. Jules is even rallying her book club to help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's cool, but do you think they'd take a wobbly chair too? It's been bugging me for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Next Saturday morning. Community center, like I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, the community center! I'm planning to bring my blender—heard it can work wonders!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: A blender, huh? That's... creative. I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it might be this Saturday, but I'm not sure. Do you know more, Eli?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure of the exact time yet, Nell. I'm hoping someone will firm that up soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, I guess we'll just have to wait and see. Have you heard what they're planning to fix?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 9 AM on Saturday at Mrs. Gable's on Elm, got it. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll bring my portable lights too, just in case we need to extend the session a bit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That's a good idea, Gus. I'll grab my toolbox and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, so hex wrenches and a sturdy screwdriver. I'll grab those first before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sounds like a solid plan. I'll try to swing by after my morning coffee, tools in hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll have them ready by then. Just let me know if you need anything else before you come.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Opal, good timing. I've got piles of lumber and tools sorted, but we're still short on nails. You wouldn't happen to have any stashed away?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think I’ve got a couple of half-full boxes in my garage. Let me check—I’ll bring them by later today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That'd be perfect, Opal. Every nail counts. I'll be here sorting till evening if you want to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I'm helping organize the repair drive schedule. Can we chat about a good time to plan?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Faye! Yeah, the repair drive... I think it's this Saturday? Or maybe last week—I keep mixing up my days lately.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's this Saturday, Noah—I just checked with Mara. How does tomorrow evening at 6 PM sound to sort out the details?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Dane's on board too! This is shaping up to be quite the event. You're not going to want to miss it, Sam!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm already looking forward to it, Quinn! Just let me know if you need my truck for anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, your truck would be a huge help! We could haul all the donated furniture and tools with ease.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sam, could you swing by tomorrow morning to help sort through the donated tools? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'll be there too, Cleo! I can help sort—my old blender's already on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Tess! That blender will be a perfect candidate for the repair station. See you both tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Say, Opal, have you heard when that repair drive's actually kicking off? I've got a chair that's more wobble than wood at this point.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I believe it's this Saturday, though I'm not sure on the exact start time. I saw the repair truck over at Mrs. Gable's earlier, so they're already at work!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's a relief — sounds like things are moving along. Did you see anyone hauling out tools from the truck?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Honestly, I'm not entirely sure—I've just been catching bits from the grapevine. Have you heard any specifics?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I heard something about the community center's roof—maybe some leaks? Not too sure though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Gus, I'm thinking of joining the repair drive. Got a few things that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rey! I'll bring my toolbox and some work lights just in case we need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That'd be real helpful, Gus. I'm mostly worried about my porch step, but I bet you'll have the right stuff.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Uli, I'm so glad I caught you! We're pulling together a repair drive this Saturday — the whole block's chipping in, and I'd love for you to be part of it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Saturday... I'll see if I can come, but I've got a few things to sort out at home.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally understand! Even if you can only stop by for a bit, we could use your sharp eye for detail — no pressure at all.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 6 PM tomorrow it is. I'll grab my calendar and we can start mapping everything out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good. I'll bring my toolbox and some spare parts for the garden shears.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Eli! Having your tools will be a big help. Let's coordinate so we can maximize our time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... do you remember what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, it's for fixing up old appliances and furniture folks are donating. I'm helping Cleo sort tools tomorrow—want me to keep an eye out for your toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That'd be real kind of you, Sam. I swear that toolbox has legs sometimes. Did I mention I'm supposed to bring my hammer for the fence?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Pia, do we have those hex wrenches and a sturdy screwdriver on hand, or should I check Leo's shed for them?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Hana, I'm not sure—I've been so focused on the daylight issue, I haven't checked our tool inventory yet. Could you please take a look in Leo's shed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I'll head over to Leo's shed and see what he's got. Be right back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, sorry I'm late again—just like I said. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We're starting at 9 AM Saturday at Mrs. Gable's on Elm Street—leaky roof and some fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll swing by around 10—grab me a hammer and I'll patch up what I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I thought it was this Saturday... or maybe last week. I can never keep track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You know what, you're right to be confused — I think it got moved around a bit, but it's definitely happening this weekend. I've already got my toaster lined up!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This weekend, huh? I'm still not sure if I've got the right day... Did you say you needed nails for something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's great Dane! Late Saturday works. And Faye, 6 PM tomorrow sounds perfect—I'll be there with any sign-up sheets I can put together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring my broken lawnmower then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh perfect, Leo! I'll add you to the list—bring the mower by, and we'll see if we can get it humming again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about helping? I thought you were just making small talk.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, absolutely serious! I've got a whole list of folks pitching in. Can we count you in for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday morning? You mean, people are really going to show up and fix things for free? I need to see it to believe it.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
